edits.old:
Discover the World in 3D

Explore the beauty of the world like never before with our interactive globe. This three-dimensional cartography tool provides a unique experience by showcasing global landscapes and terrain mapping in exceptional detail.

An Educational and Interactive Tool for Everyone

Whether you're an educator, student, or geography enthusiast, our 3D World Map Model is designed to serve as an invaluable educational tool. It provides a deeper understanding of the Earth's features through spatial modeling and detailed global dataset visualization.

Ideal for Cartographic Design and Virtual Environments

Our world map model is ideal for those looking to enhance their virtual environment designs. With precise cartographic design, this model brings geography to life, offering a compelling tool for professional and personal projects.

Perfect for Topographic and Terrain Mapping

Featuring high-quality terrain mapping, this 3D world map is designed to capture the Earth's physical geography in stunning accuracy. Use it to visualize elevations, geographic features, and landscape layouts, making it ideal for professional and academic applications.
edits.text:
A world map with raised terrain

The rectangular layout shows terrain across the world on a map surface. Open the model in your 3D software to compose an overview or choose an angled camera view for map illustrations, presentation graphics and animated scenes.

Included formats and satellite texture

The C4D, FBX and OBJ files are supplied with UV mapping and a 21600 x 10800 px TIF satellite texture. The mesh has an open base. Before 3D printing or CNC machining, check and prepare the geometry for your intended workflow.

Choosing between the World models

This product combines the terrain model and satellite texture in a C4D/FBX/OBJ package. For a bundle with height, normal and water maps, compare the separate World Earth Map 3D Model linked below.
